notes.title: Full walkthrough of the demo
notes.notes: You can watch a developer play, the total playthrough is about 1 hour long!

notes.title: Kryva Hora Single Player Demo is now available
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers,

We built a single player demo for you for the Steam Next fest, you can try several features we implemented and we would like to use in the final game.

Please note that the multiplayer functions are not available yet. 

Let us know what do you think!
